gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 diagnoses reversed signs and a false cancellation in Proposition 2's defect calculation. The gold issue instead concerns the omitted epsilon b term in the comparison function and the resulting failure of the claimed O(epsilon^2) approximation. These are different formula-level failures in the same proposition.

ISSUE-002 identifies non-uniformity of the stability lemma's eigenvector norm-equivalence constant. The gold issue requires an A(R)-norm consistency estimate, because the available maximum-norm defect estimate cannot be inserted into the stability lemma; the prediction does not diagnose or repair that missing norm estimate. ISSUE-003 likewise concerns a separate implicit Crank–Nicolson stability argument and does not supply the missing A(R)-norm consistency diagnosis.
